label: Trailer Cinematográfico (45s) · Abismo Silencioso (Mistério Submarino)
description: Trailer de ficção submarina e mistério em 16:9: submarino de exploração descendo a 11.000 metros de profundidade na Fossa das Marianas, luzes de halogênio na escuridão aquática total, bioluminescência alienígena e pressão colossal.

scenes.prompt: Deep ocean sci-fi thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. A lone high-tech research submersible descends into pitch-black oceanic darkness. Two powerful halogen floodlights cut through murky deep waters filled with drifting marine snow. 35mm cinema lens, cold cyan and deep sapphire blue color grading. Non-verbal sound design: deep muffled water pressure drone, periodic metallic sonar ping. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: 11.000 METROS ABAIXO.

Deep ocean sci-fi thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Close-up inside the submersible cockpit on a mechanical pressure gauge needle trembling as it crosses red critical zone limits. Condensation drips from heavy reinforced titanium viewport bolts. Non-verbal sound design: creaking titanium hull under extreme hydrostatic pressure, rapid heart-rate monitor. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A PRESSÃO É TOTAL.

Deep ocean sci-fi thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Submersible floodlights suddenly reveal a colossal submerged monolithic structure half-buried in the abyssal trench seabed, glowing with organic bioluminescent emerald patterns. Massive sense of scale. Non-verbal sound design: deep echoing whale-like frequency roar from the abyss and massive sub-bass impact. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: NÃO ESTAMOS SOZINHOS.

Deep ocean sci-fi thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Rapid kinetic underwater cuts: electrical sparks bursting inside the cockpit, submersible rolling into a dark oceanic trench, a colossal tentacled shadow gliding past the main glass viewport. Non-verbal sound design: rushing bubbles, underwater hull alarms, massive low-end whoosh. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A ESCURIDÃO RESPONDEU.

Deep ocean sci-fi thriller trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: fractured, frosted deep-sea 3D typography illuminated by flickering submarine headlights against the infinite black ocean floor. Non-verbal sound design: profound oceanic silence ending in one single sharp sonar ping with infinite reverb. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: ABISMO SILENCIOSO.

narration.text: Conhecemos a superfície da lua melhor do que as profundezas do nosso próprio planeta. Mas existem lugares onde a luz do sol nunca chegou. E o que vive lá... não quer ser perturbado.
narration.voice: voz feminina brasileira madura, grave, tensa, pausada, sussurrada e científica, estilo thriller de suspense e ficção

blocks.text: Conhecemos as estrelas melhor do que nossos oceanos.
Onde a luz do sol nunca alcançou, a pressão é absoluta.
O que encontramos no fundo do abismo não é humano.
E agora, não há como voltar à superfície.
Abismo Silencioso. O segredo mais profundo da Terra.

audio.musicIntent: Suspenseful abyssal orchestral score with underwater hydrophone textures, bowed metallic waterphones, deep sub-bass drones and sudden terrifying percussion hits.
